description: Arceaux de stationnement vélo - Angers is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by paysdelaloire.opendatasoft.com. Location and number by bike parking grouping.Description of the main fields of the dataset:[NAME ]: Name of the geographical object[ARCNB]: number of bicycle poles on the [LIBVOI] site: Track wording [DATEMAJ]: Data update date[SOURCE]: data sourceGeographic objects were digitized on orthophotographs and from field surveys. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle parking poles - Angers" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include vélo, arceaux, borne. The listing shows 2024-07-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
